topic: Exploring the 2-adic Metric: Convergence Beyond Real Numbers

sections.title: The Intuition of 'Nearness'
lecture_lines: Euclidean distance measures gaps on a number line.
P-adic distance counts how often 2 divides.
High powers of 2 make numbers feel small.
Nearness depends entirely on our metric choice.
